name: context-health-bar
description: Visual battery-style health bar showing context consumption, color-coded from red (heavy) to green (light)

maxTokens.title: Max Tokens
maxTokens.description: Fallback max tokens shown before the real context window is known (9 bars total, 3 per color); once available, the model's actual window size is used instead

redThreshold.title: Red Threshold
redThreshold.description: Tokens used at which the red /passagem + /clear tip is appended to the status bar

yellowThreshold.title: Yellow Threshold
yellowThreshold.description: Tokens used at which the status bar moves to the yellow zone (reference parity with the statusline script; documentation only)
